articles.description: TL;DR: Over the past year indie horror games have shifted from cute-but-creepy mascots (think early FNAF vibes) to much darker, twisted narratives. articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
TL;DR:

MatPat’s latest Game Theory episode plugs a sweet deal on Factor boxes (use code 50GAMETHEORY for 50% off + free shipping) before diving into the surprisingly deep lore of Roblox Pressure. What started as another knock-off has blossomed into its own indie darling complete with unique mechanics, new creatures and a story worth exploring.
Bonus deets:

The vid’s brought to you by Epidemic Sound (30-day free trial), and credits roll for writers Tom Robinson, Daniel Zemke, Melissa Yinger; editors like Tyler Mascola; sound designers Yosi Berman & Alena Lecorchick; plus thumbnail artist DasGnomo.
articles.title: The Game Theorists: Game Theory: The Lore of Roblox Pressure Explained (Yes, Finally!)

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Think Death Stranding was a head-scratcher? This timeline guide lays out every pivotal moment in Kojima’s twisted saga, kicking off with the universe-shattering Big Bang and Bridget Strand’s fateful rise.
From the first Voidout and Sam’s cross-country drudgery to the planet-shaking Death Stranding event, Lucy’s secrets, Homo Demens’ revolt, the birth of the Chiral Network and the mysterious Last Stranding, each chapter comes with its own timestamp to help you piece together the lore before the sequel drops.
articles.title: GameSpot: The Complete DEATH STRANDING Timeline

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
TL;DR: Voice-actor Ben Starr (Final Fantasy XVI, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33) drops into the GameSpot studio to flex his weirdest chops yet: he’s voicing 17 different doors in a mock-dating series called “Date Everything.” From Front Door Dorian and Underclothed Dorian to Trap Door Dorian and even a love-struck Wall, each timestamped bit turns hallways, beds and walls into full-blown romance partners.
Expect cheeky sketches, a handful of musical deep dives and plenty of “dangerous thoughts” as Starr embraces every surface of love — literally all around us.
articles.title: GameSpot: Voice Actor Ben Starr Dates Himself

articles.description:
The video drops you into an Armed Survivalists encampment in Death Stranding 2 on the hardest difficulty, pitting raw firepower against crafty guerrilla tactics. You’ll see the host brute-forcing their way in, then pivoting to oddball strategies that catch the enemy off-guard.
Quick hits:  
1:00 – “Delivering Pain” combat montage

3:51 – Unconventional tactics and tricks

10:00 – Full “Hardest Difficulty” playthrough
articles.title: GameSpot: Delivering Nothing But PAIN In Death Stranding 2 - Brutal Difficulty Gameplay

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
TL;DR

Donkey Kong Bananza is the most ambitious DK game in years—a fresh 3D platformer from the Super Mario Odyssey crew. It throws in wild twists like real-time terrain deformation, multiple Kong transformations and even a tween Pauline sidekick.
After an extended hands-on, the mash-up of crazy mechanics actually clicks, feeling like a natural evolution of Odyssey’s best ideas while winking at the blocky charm of Nintendo 64 classics.
articles.title: GameSpot: Donkey Kong Bananza Looks Like The Mario Odyssey Successor No One Expected | Hands-On Impressions

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Diablo 4’s “Sins of the Horadrim” Update Sneak Peek

Blizzard’s latest patch adds a heap of fresh endgame content: dive into Horadric Strongrooms, tackle ever-more brutal Escalating Nightmares, tinker with Customizable Spells and deck out your build with new Horadric Jewels.  
Plus, you’ll spot tons of QoL tweaks in the overview vid. Mark your calendars—this drops July 1 on PS4/PS5, Xbox One/Series X|S and PC (Steam & Battle.net).
articles.title: IGN: Diablo 4 - Official Sins of the Horadrim Update Overview

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
TL;DR: FBC: Firebreak mixes Remedy’s signature cryptic style with zippy, approachable combat and eye-popping graphical flair. Teamwork is key—coordinating with friends makes missions a blast, but random or solo play can feel like a slog.
Despite the chaos and addictive “just one more run” vibe, the game’s small roster of levels and upgrades leaves it feeling more like a short-term gig than a long-haul career. Still, if you’ve got a squad, it’s hard to resist diving back into this perilous playground.
articles.title: IGN: FBC: Firebreak Review

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
TL;DR: Laura Fryer, one of the OG Xbox hardware pioneers, just bluntly called Xbox hardware “dead” after Microsoft teamed up with ROG for the new handheld ROG XBOX Ally X—she sees it as Xbox washing its hands of the hardware side. That said, a fresh AMD partnership and Xbox’s 25th-year anniversary tease might mean they aren’t totally checked out yet.
On the flip side, Assassin’s Creed fans got excited when Edward Kenway’s voice actor dropped major hints about a Black Flag remake (Ubisoft still mum), and EA Sports officially announced it’s bringing back college basketball games for the first time in 16 years now that NCAA players can cash in on their likeness.
articles.title: IGN: 'Xbox Hardware Is Dead,' Says Founding Team Member | IGN Daily The Fix
